IGUI_SEW_Closer: No way to it from here. Stand right at it and try again.
IGUI_SEW_Unready: Something is blocking the shaft. Try again.
IGUI_SEW_Rescued: You find your way back to a ladder.
IGUI_SEW_DevCave: Dev build: a cave is a climb and a short walk from this cover.
IGUI_SEW_AmbienceTip: Now and then while you are in the sewers: a drip, something scuttling in the wall, a groan from far off. Only you hear them. Off unless ticked.
IGUI_SEW_MapFooter: %1 walked   -   %2 shelters found   -   drag to move, wheel to zoom
IGUI_SEW_J_maintenance_1_Body:
Aug 2. Three of us sent down to clear the storm grates.
County won't say what's washing into them.

We're keeping the tool room %2 of here, under %1.
Steel door. Water, tools, a cot.

If you're reading this: the key is where it always is.
IGUI_SEW_J_maintenance_2_Body:
Nobody came to relieve us. The radio is just static now.

We moved everything we could carry to the maintenance
room %2 of here, under %1.

The door is steel. Don't let them follow you in.
IGUI_SEW_J_pump_1_Body:
The pumps are the only thing keeping the low culverts dry.

There is a pump station %2 of here, under %1.
It still runs if you feed it gasoline.

When it rains up top, the water comes down here fast.
IGUI_SEW_J_pump_2_Body:
Found the old pump house %2 of here, under %1.
Diesel smell. Big iron wheels. Mike thinks he can
get it going again.

If the water rises, that's where we go.
IGUI_SEW_J_squat_1_Body:
Day 9 underground. Slept in a side room %2 of here,
under %1. Somebody had set it up nice. Candles. Cans.

They left in a hurry. Left their bag.
I didn't touch it.
IGUI_SEW_J_squat_2_Body:
Ellie says there are people living %2 of here,
under %1. We heard them singing through the pipes.

We're going to knock. Three times,
like it says on the wall.
IGUI_SEW_J_laststand_1_Body:
They came down the ladder behind us.
We held them at the door %2 of here, under %1.

Tommy is still in there.
Don't open it. Please don't open it.
IGUI_SEW_J_laststand_2_Body:
Guns and food stacked in the room %2 of here, under %1.
We're making our stand there.

If we don't come back, take what's left.
Better you than them.
IGUI_SEW_J_shaft_1_Body:
There's a ladder out %2 of here, under %1.
The cover's loose. At noon the daylight comes
through the holes.

I counted every step. Four hundred and twelve.
IGUI_SEW_J_shaft_2_Body:
If you're lost, go %2. There's a way up under %1.
I marked it on the wall with an arrow.

Keep your light off. They hear it.
IGUI_SEW_PlanRevealed: The plan fills in %1 stretches of tunnel on your sewer map.
IGUI_SEW_PlanKnown: Nothing on this sheet you don't already know.
IGUI_SEW_RousAlive: Not while something in the nest is still breathing.
IGUI_SEW_NestWall: The bricks come away. Behind them, a tunnel nobody dug with a shovel.
IGUI_SEW_NestGate: The last of the brick gives. There is a room behind it, and it is full.
IGUI_SEW_NestCleared: The nest is still. Behind the gnawed wall, something catches the light.
IGUI_SEW_DevLair: Dev build: down this hatch, the false wall into the rats' nest is a short walk away.
IGUI_SEW_GasIn: The air here is thick and sour. You can taste it.
IGUI_SEW_GasMask: Your mask hisses. You can smell it even through the filter.
IGUI_SEW_DownOutfall: Down into the storm drain. The water's roar fades behind you.
IGUI_SEW_UpOutfall: Out onto the bank, by the water.
IGUI_SEW_DownDrain: You squeeze down through the drain. The street is a strip of light overhead.
IGUI_SEW_UpDrain: You squeeze out through the grate, onto the kerb.
IGUI_SEW_DrainBig: You do not fit. A kerb drain is too narrow for you.
IGUI_SEW_DrainLoad: You do not fit with all that. You are carrying too much to squeeze through.
IGUI_SEW_DevOutfall: Dev build: a storm-drain outfall's grate is in this bank. Gas mask and filter in your bag.
IGUI_SEW_DevDrain: Dev build: a kerb storm drain is a square north of you, with a ladder under it.
IGUI_SEW_DevAtGas: Dev build: sewer gas, stretch %1 of %2. Mask off to feel it, mask on to breathe.
IGUI_SEW_DevAtGate: Dev build: locked gate %1 of %2. It should not open without the key.
IGUI_SEW_DevKey: Dev build: the Sewer Maintenance Key is in your inventory.
IGUI_SEW_DevGun: Dev build: %1 things in your inventory. Load the magazine, load the pistol, and go and find the nest.
IGUI_SEW_DevFire: Dev build: %1 squares of street alight over the tunnel. Give it a minute, then climb down and look.
IGUI_SEW_DevSnowOn: Dev build: snow on the ground. Climb down: none of it should lie in the tunnel.
IGUI_SEW_DevWindOn: Dev build: ten below and a gale. The wind chill moodle should show on the street and go below.
IGUI_SEW_DevWindOff: Dev build: the wind and the cold are the game's again.
IGUI_SEW_DevSnowOff: Dev build: the weather is the game's again.
IGUI_SEW_DevPoison: Dev build: poison %1 (it costs health above 10).
IGUI_SEW_TempleHall: Firelight. Rows of pews. And at the far end, something carved with its paws raised.
IGUI_SEW_J_cult_1_Body:
This house is not the Burrow. This house is where we wait.

The Great Ones do not live here. They live %2 of this place,
under the city, under %1, behind a wall that is not a wall:
loose brick, and a hole at its foot gnawed by no dog.

Four sleep there on the bones of the unworthy. Behind them
is all that the world above ever hoarded, and they keep it.

Go to them with empty hands. They provide.
IGUI_SEW_J_cult_2_Body:
Wk 3. Two from the feed store. One from the highway. Given.
Wk 4. None taken. The Elder says the Great Ones are displeased.
Wk 5. Brother Amos sent %2 with the chalice and the robes,
to the nest under %1. He was to leave them in the second den,
past the bones, where the first of us lie. He did not come back.
The Elder says that means it was accepted.

Wk 6. The pens are full again. The city is burning.
The Elder says we are next, and that it is an honor.
IGUI_SEW_J_cult_3_Body:
Mama, I am well. We dug for two months to reach the county's
tunnels, one way to the north and one to the south, so we never
have to walk under the sky again.

There is a ladder in the back room that comes up in the field.
I am not supposed to know about it.

They say the real ones, the big ones, are %2 of here under %1.
I have only seen the statue. I hope that is all I ever see.
IGUI_SEW_DevTemple: Dev build: the temple is under this field. Its trapdoor is one square north of you.
IGUI_SEW_DevAtTemple: Dev build: the foot of the temple's hall. The idol is at the far end.
IGUI_SEW_DevAtBreach: Dev build: the cult broke through this wall. Their passage runs %1 squares to the temple.
IGUI_SEW_J_cult_4_Body:
For those the Elder sends to the Burrow.

Do not go down by the street. In the city there is a house
with a door in its floor, near %1. One of ours cut it.
Go down there, and follow the pipe to the wall with the hole
at its foot.

Past the wall: the round den where the Four sleep, and beyond
it the lesser dens. Leave what you carry in the second.
Do not go into the deepest. That one is theirs.
IGUI_SEW_J_warren_1_Body:
I have left the chalice where I was told. They watched me do it.

If you are not one of us and you are reading this: our house
is %2 of here, under the fields between Muldraugh and
West Point. There is a trapdoor in the field west of the road.
I left it unlatched. I always meant to go back up that way.

The Elder is wrong about them. They do not provide.
They only keep.
IGUI_SEW_J_warren_2_Title: A map on a hymn sheet
IGUI_SEW_J_warren_2_Body:
Drawn in pencil on the back of a hymn: two lines of pipe, a
square between them, and the square marked HOME.

North way: the county's pipe under %1,
where we broke the wall. Look for our mark and the candles.
Two hundred and fifty paces south through the earth we dug.

Underneath, in another hand: all the gold came here.
None of it ever came back.
IGUI_SEW_J_warren_3_Body:
Jul 14. Crew of three sent to Louisville for the rat complaint.
Found a false wall. Found what is behind it. Henley is dead.

Same thing we logged last month, %2 of here, in the little
system under %1: a hole knocked in the wall from
the OUTSIDE, candles, that rat's head painted on the brick.
Somebody dug a tunnel to our pipe. We reported it. Nobody came.

Whoever they are, they knew about this place before we did.

IGUI_SEW_DevAtHeart: Dev build: the last corridor. The heart's door is beside you, and you are not alone.
